pages.raw_meta: Discover how American Integrity Insurance was founded after a devastating storm season in Florida – built on integrity, strength, and a commitment to protecting homeowners.
raw_blocks: "The name American Integrity Insurance was chosen because the business was founded during a time when the industry was overwhelmed with integrity issues." - Robert "Bob" Ritchie

Our Founder & CEO, Robert “Bob” Ritchie, created American Integrity Insurance in 2006 in response to the overwhelming shortage of sound home insurance choices in Florida. After the unprecedented hurricane season of 2004, many insurance companies went out of business, leaving their policyholders scrambling to find new coverage.

At the same time, many national carriers reduced their footprint in Florida, finding the risk in our state to be too great. Other companies just stopped writing new business, waiting for the dust to settle in the aftermath of the hurricanes. To most people, this wouldn’t appear to have been the ideal time to create an insurance company, but Bob saw things differently.
Our Inspiring Journey Through the Years
American Integrity Insurance began with a vision to provide tailored insurance solutions. Our founder's journey from humble beginnings to industry leader is a testament to dedication and passion.
American Integrity Insurance Group was founded with a mission to provide reliable, customer-focused homeowners insurance tailored to Floridians.
The company began serving customers across Florida by issuing its first official policy.
American Integrity reached 100,000 policies in force (PIF) and was named one of the Best Places to Work by Business Insurance for the first time.
American Integrity surpassed 200,000 policies in force.
Sebo v. AHAC was a driving force in the roof crisis, resulting in rampant litigation, inflated roof claims, and increased policyholder premiums.
Hurricane Irma, one of the most destructive and deadly Category 4 storms, inflicted tens of billions in losses to residential and commercial property throughout the Southeast.
This year saw the peak of rampant abuse of Assignment of Benefits (AOB) contracts by lawyers and contractors which led to fraud, lawsuits, and skyrocketing premiums.
The AOB Reform law created a partial fix to the roofing crisis by helping consumers maintain control of their claims and mitigating abusive contractor activity.
American Integrity was recognized as a USA TODAY Top Workplace for the first time.

In 2022, Hurricane Ian’s devastation underscored the need for insurance reform. SB 2A helped stabilize Florida’s market by ending one-way attorney fees and banning AOBs. That same year, American Integrity began expanding into South Carolina, marking its growth into a regional Southeast insurer.

American Integrity entered the Georgia market, strengthening its presence and coverage throughout the Southeast. In the same year, they also grew to 300,000 policies in force and announced their intent for an Initial Public Offering (IPO).
American Integrity rang the closing bell at the New York Stock Exchange after its successful IPO, marking a new era of opportunity.
In addition, the company surpassed 400,000 policies in force and entered the Commercial Insurance market in Florida.
Our Commitment to Improving the Insurance Market

American Integrity Insurance is committed to providing homeowners with sound, comprehensive insurance coverage and an extraordinary customer experience. We strive to be a valued partner to our policyholders, agents, and community.

We offer traditional and high value homeowners' insurance, condo insurance, and the special coverage required for vacant homes, manufactured homes, and policies designed for those who need less coverage or are renting out their home. We also offer extra protection, including flood insurance as well as identity theft and equipment breakdown coverage, to help address a broad range of needs facing homeowners today.

Imagine a place where insurance is exciting… That's American Integrity! From charity events to company picnics, our employees put the “A” and “I” in family. Working hard and having fun is in our company's genes. And as with our mascot, Leo the Loyal Lion, our strength lies within.
We have been recognized as a Top Place to Work in Tampa by the Tampa Bay Times and a Best Places to Work in Insurance by Business Insurance magazine several times, sparking companywide celebrations!
Volunteerism, working hard, and having fun are the cornerstones of our unique workplace.
Our Mascot: Leo the Lion

Leo the Lion proudly stands as the official mascot of American Integrity Insurance Group, reigning as the King of Florida’s Home Insurance Marketplace. The lion symbolizes fearless commitment, moral strength, and the leadership that true integrity requires — a powerful reminder that doing the right thing is the strongest position any leader, or company, can hold.

When he’s not busy representing our brand throughout the Southeast, Leo can be found watching cat videos on YouTube, taking selfies, sharpening his claws, and sneaking in a cat nap or two. As the living symbol of our commitment to integrity, we couldn’t be happier to have Leo at the heart of the American Integrity family.
Contact an agent and get started on your customized coverage today!

pages.raw_meta: Explore homeowners, condo, rental, flood, and more insurance options across FL, GA, & SC. Protect your home and lifestyle with trusted coverage.
raw_blocks: Insurance options tailored to the needs of homeowners across each state we serve. Select your state to explore available coverage.

We’re here to help protect your home from Florida’s unique challenges with our broad coverage options including those for new construction, high-valued homes, condos, older homes, manufactured homes, renters, flood, cyber, and more.

Whether it's your vacation getaway, a vacant home, a short-term rental, or a seasonal rental property, our secondary and seasonal dwelling insurance ensures that your investment is protected year-round from Florida’s unique risks.

Golf carts are a great way to get around, whether it’s on the course or in your community. With our Golf Cart Insurance, you can enjoy your rides knowing your cart is protected from accidents, theft, and liability.
Whether you’re out on the water for leisure or sport, our Watercraft Insurance offers comprehensive coverage to keep your boat, personal watercraft, or Jet Ski ® protected from the unexpected.
From installing protective devices in your home to being a senior or retiree, we offer a range of discounts to help keep your home insurance affordable.

From beaches to mountains, American Integrity provides comprehensive coverage for Georgia homeowners insurance so you can enjoy peace of mind in your newly constructed home (built in the last 12 years).

Golf carts offer a fun and convenient way to travel—on the course or around your neighborhood. With our Golf Cart Insurance, you can ride confidently knowing your cart is covered against accidents, theft, and liability.

Standard homeowners insurance excludes flood coverage, leaving you at risk. Add a flood endorsement to protect your Georgia home and belongings from unpredictable water damage with rates that are typically 15% lower than the NFIP.
From using an accredited builder to installing protective devices in your home, we offer a range of discounts to help keep your Georgia home insurance affordable.
From sandy beaches to picturesque mountains, American Integrity provides comprehensive homeowners insurance throughout South Carolina so you can relax and enjoy your home with peace of mind.
The most common and costliest natural disaster in the U.S. is flooding. Flood protection is not included on a standard homeowners insurance policy, so it’s important to make sure you’re covered.
From living in a secured community to opting for a paperless policy, we offer a range of discounts to help keep your South Carolina home insurance affordable.
Our HO-5 policy is built for newer homes up to 5 years old, providing extensive protection against common risks, so you can have peace of mind.
From multi-policy bundles to discounts for newer homes and protective devices, our North Carolina homeowners enjoy comprehensive coverage without breaking the bank.
Learn more about homeowners and residential insurance

Putting our products to the test when the unexpected occurs
Don’t just take it from us – hear from real customers about how our Claims Team helped rebuild their homes after a loss.
We get it, the details of insurance policies are complex. These answers to some of our most commonly asked questions should help make it a little easier.
Your premium is based on factors like the value of your home or personal property, your location, and the types of coverage you select.
The declarations page on your policy will outline specific coverages, including what’s protected and what’s not. We recommend reviewing your policy with an agent to fully understand your protection.

You can file a claim with American Integrity by calling our 24/7 claims line at 1-866-277-9871 or filing online through our Customer Portal . If you have tropical storm or hurricane-related damage, please call 844-MYAIIC1 (844-692-4421).

Yes! As your needs change, you can adjust your coverage to make sure you’re always fully protected. You can also add additional insureds, like a co-owner or spouse, who have a financial interest in your property. Talk to your agent to update your policy.

We offer coverage designed for the Southeast’s unique risks, like hurricanes and flooding, supported by deep local expertise and outstanding service. Our broad product portfolio covers everything from homes to boats, golf carts, and rental properties—always with integrity at the heart of what we do.
Click here to use our Agent Locator Tool ! All we need is your zip code and we’ll give you a list of nearby agents to choose from.
Work with our knowledgeable experts to get the right coverage for your unique situation.
